entries.text: Hi, it's Sarah from HeliumDeploy. Thanks for taking a few minutes with me: your 10% off code shows up on screen as soon as we finish. I see you were looking at the Bugatti Gatsby Carry-On. What caught your eye?
It's for a two week trip to Portugal with my wife in November. We fly Air Transat.
A two-week trip to Portugal in November sounds lovely. What matters most to you in choosing a carry-on for it?
Mostly it has to fit the carry on size limit. And be light. I really hate heavy bags.
Heavy bags are the worst, I agree. Have you looked at any other carry-ons, maybe at other stores or on Amazon?
I looked at Samsonite on Amazon and something at Costco. But the Bugatti looks nicer.
Good to hear the Bugatti wins on looks. What would make you buy it today, or is something holding you back?
Honestly, I just want to know the exact dimensions. And if shipping is fast enough before the trip,
I don't have the exact dimensions or shipping times, and I won't guess. I'll scroll your page to the details, and the store's policy pages cover shipping.
Since your trip is in November, timing clearly matters. How did you first find HeliumDeploy?
I saw an Instagram ad a few days ago. That's how I found you.

Thanks, an Instagram ad a few days ago, that's helpful to know. Thank you so much for your time, and enjoy Portugal with your wife. Your code will appear on screen as soon as you press "End call". Goodbye!
No. I think that covers it. Thanks a lot. Bye.
